skill.name: testing-patterns
skill.description: Vitest testing patterns and strategies for unit tests, agent tests, API route tests, and Supabase mocking.
skill.summary: Create consistent Vitest tests for TypeScript services, agents, API routes, and Supabase integrations.
skill.author: CleanExpo

content.value_statement: Teams need consistent tests for TypeScript services, agents, and API routes. This skill provides Vitest patterns with Supabase mocks and clear pass-rate expectations.
actual_capabilities: Shows a Vitest unit test structure for TypeScript services.
Provides an agent test pattern with mocked Supabase client behavior.
Demonstrates API route testing with NextRequest and response assertions.
Defines reusable Supabase mock functions for select, eq, and insert calls.
Lists coverage targets for unit, integration, and end-to-end tests.
limitations: Does not generate complete test suites for a specific codebase by itself.
Does not include Playwright examples beyond naming end-to-end coverage needs.
Uses simplified placeholder services, agents, and routes.
Requires users to adapt imports, fixtures, and assertions to their project.

use_cases.title: Standardize Feature Tests
use_cases.description: Apply a shared Vitest structure when adding service tests for new TypeScript features.

use_cases.title: Mock Supabase Workflows
use_cases.description: Build predictable tests for agents and database-facing code without calling a live Supabase project.

use_cases.title: Verify API Error Handling
use_cases.description: Use API route test patterns to check required parameters, status codes, and response error messages.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Unit Test
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a service test scaffold.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the testing-patterns skill to outline a Vitest unit test for my TypeScript service. Include setup, one success case, and one error case.

prompt_templates.title: Mock a Supabase Dependency
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for database mocking guidance.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the testing-patterns skill to design a Vitest test for code that reads from Supabase. Show the mock behavior I should configure.

prompt_templates.title: Test an API Route
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for route validation tests.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the testing-patterns skill to plan tests for a Next.js API route that requires workspace_id and returns validation errors.

prompt_templates.title: Review Test Coverage Strategy
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for improving a project test plan.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the testing-patterns skill to review my current test plan. Identify missing unit, integration, agent, and end-to-end coverage areas.

output_examples.input: Request a unit test pattern for a service method that processes input and rejects invalid values.
output_examples.output: A concise test outline with setup steps, a successful processing case, and an error assertion for invalid input.

output_examples.input: Request guidance for testing an agent that reads tasks through Supabase.
output_examples.output: A mock plan that replaces the Supabase client, returns controlled data, and verifies the agent result.

output_examples.input: Request an API route test for missing required parameters.
output_examples.output: A route test plan that builds a local request, calls the handler, and checks the expected status and error message.

best_practices: Clear mocks before each test so earlier assertions do not affect later cases.
Assert both successful behavior and expected error handling paths.
Keep Supabase calls mocked unless a test is explicitly an integration test.
anti_patterns: Do not call a live Supabase project from ordinary unit tests.
Do not rely only on a success case when the code validates required input.
Do not leave placeholder imports or route names unchanged in real tests.

faq.question: What test framework does this skill use?
faq.answer: It uses Vitest for unit tests, agent tests, and API route tests.

faq.question: Can it help with Supabase tests?
faq.answer: Yes. It shows how to mock the Supabase client and common query methods.

faq.question: Does it replace project-specific test design?
faq.answer: No. It provides patterns that users must adapt to real imports, data, and behavior.

faq.question: Does it include end-to-end test examples?
faq.answer: No. It names end-to-end coverage as a requirement but does not provide Playwright patterns.

faq.question: Is this useful with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The prompts and patterns can guide all three tools when creating or reviewing tests.

faq.question: Does the skill require network access?
faq.answer: No. The only URL shown is a localhost test request for an API route example.
